title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-04-05
content:
Quick notes for 2026-04-05

AM context:
- Oncall yesterday evening: memory spike on model-v2 when seq_len > 2048 (see JIRA-ENG-3421). Got a partial mitigation by reverting last kernel scheduling change. Need root cause.
- Perf dashboards show 12% increased p95 token latency for small-batch (<4) workloads since 04-03 rollout. Might be batching heuristic regression.

Top priorities:
1) Bug triage: JIRA-ENG-3421 (mem spike)
   - Repro steps: local run with gpus=4, model: llama-33B-q4, seq_len=4096, concurrent=8 -> OOM after ~550 steps.
   - Hypothesis: KV cache eviction race with async garbage collector after kernel switch.
   - Quick checks to run today: add verbose KV alloc logs, run with --disable-async-gc to see if stable, repro on devbox-7.
   - Next: if disables async GC fixes, schedule revert + deeper fix for GC ordering.

2) Perf regression: small-batch p95 increase (JIRA-ENG-3480)
   - Compare batching windows: current heuristic uses 8ms max wait; previous was 5ms. Increasing wait could hurt p95 for tiny jobs (PLG traffic).
   - Experiment plan: A/B config on canary pool: set max_wait_ms=5 vs 8 for 24h, measure p50/p95 and cost per token.
   - Metric hooks: add route-level trace to console for token latency buckets, enable sampling for traces 1/100.

3) Kernel notes / TODOs:
   - Review recent kernel scheduling PR (PR #789). Key change: reorder of compute dispatch to prefer fused-attn when len%32==0. Edge case: fallback path memory not precharged.
   - TODO: add precharge step for fallback path to pre-alloc temp buffers to avoid transient OOMs. Put small unit test exercising len%32==1..33 to catch boundary.

Debug checklist (today):
- [ ] Reproduce mem spike on devbox-7 with 4096 seq_len (Sam to help on repro infra)
- [ ] Run with --disable-async-gc and capture heap profiles (Linux perf + pmap snapshots)
- [ ] Add KV allocator logging (fast) and push small PR to feature branch (label: debug/kv-gc)
- [ ] Launch A/B for batching window on canary pool (Lina to coordinate with infra)
- [ ] Add unit test for kernel fallback precharge and run CI locally (aim to land by EOD Fri)

Notes from yesterday's pairing w/ Lina:
- Observed that small-batch latency worse when CPU load high (scheduling jitter). Could be our coroutine scheduling interacting with python GC. Quick mitigation: bump dispatcher thread-priority for critical path (experiment only).
- Lina suggested adding microbenchmark harness that simulates PLG traffic: many sequences of length 64 arriving at Poisson rate. Useful for validating batching heuristics without real traffic.

Ideas / longer-term:
- Consider adding a lightweight in-memory prefix cache fingerprinting to avoid redoing KV loads for identical short queries within 10s window. Could reduce p95 for PLG queries a lot. Track as RFC.
- Evaluate quantization profile that reduces memory per KV by 10% for 33B models; might alleviate mem spikes under high concurrency. Coordination with applied-ml.

Meeting notes (standup 09:30):
- Action items: Sam will triage repro infra, Lina will schedule A/B and prepare dashboard slices, I will open PR for KV logging and kernel precharge test.

Random TODOs / reminders:
- Ping infra about provisioning one more devbox with 48GB A100 (tag: debug)
- File a short postmortem template for incidents like mem spike so we capture timeline and decisions (use incident-template in confluence).
- Update runbook: add step to disable async GC as temporary mitigation and whom to page if OOM repeats.

Scratch ideas (brainstorm):
- Smarter batching: dynamic per-route max_wait based on observed tail latency SLA. Need feasibility study.
- Offload KV eviction bookkeeping to a dedicated lightweight service on same node to smooth GC spikes. Heavy engineering cost but huge reliability upside.

Logs / commands I ran:
- repro: ./bin/run_local --model llama-33B-q4 --seq-len 4096 --concurrency 8 --trace-kv > /tmp/kv-trace-0405.log
- heap dump: sudo gcore -o /tmp/core-$(date +%s) $(pidof serving-runtime)
- quick perf: python tools/perf_cli.py --profile p95 --route /generate --duration 300 --samples 2000

Open questions / unknowns:
- Is the GC-induced OOM only for q4 quantized models or also for nf4/q8? Need matrix test across quant types.
- Any correlation with rollback of network driver update on devbox-7 last week? (infra change log shows kernel update 04-02).

Plan for EOD:
- If repro successful and disable-async-gc cures it -> land hotfix revert and schedule CI test.
- If repro fails -> escalate to infra to run full kernel/driver bisect with previous snapshots.

-- Jordan
